title: The Last Lamp
brief: An isolated caretaker repairs a failing lamp; only at the end do we understand someone outside needed it.
notes: Original design fixture, not Last Light Radio canon.
No model generation, source images, final audio or NLE import performed.
All six shots are five-second editorial plans; generation handles/capability must be resolved later.

characters.identity: Adult caretaker; identity and wardrobe undecided pending reference board

locations.description: One room overlooking dark water; geography to be fixed in reference board

shots.purpose: Establish a lamp that will not stay lit and the caretaker's concern.
shots.action: Caretaker turns the old lamp on; it flickers out.
shots.sound: Switch click, electrical sputter, room wind
shots.risk: Flicker must not become a rapid flashing effect

shots.purpose: Reveal the spare fuse and make repair a possible choice.
shots.framing: Insert, same side of desk axis
shots.action: Her hand opens a shallow tray, exposing one brass fuse.
shots.risk: Hand anatomy and single fuse identity

shots.purpose: Show her choosing repair rather than leaving.
shots.action: She picks up the fuse and examines its intact filament.

shots.purpose: Make the repair visible instead of magical.
shots.framing: Close on hands and opened lamp base
shots.action: She seats the fuse in the socket.
shots.risk: High hand/prop complexity; may require practical insert

shots.purpose: Confirm the consequence of her action.
shots.action: She turns the lamp on; warm steady light fills the desk.

shots.purpose: Reveal the light is a beacon, not merely her comfort.
shots.action: She sits beside the light while a distant boat passes in the dark.
